warning_texts: The completion caveats ('one quarter of orders in this channel') never say the denominator is the whole channel including cancelled and pending orders; check_plan caveats_declared accepts this phrasing by design, but a reader can still parse 0.724397 as a share among delivered orders.

gate_release_document check wording_matches_claims.all passed vacuously: its own actual reads 'no word in the dictionary appears on any surface', so it protected nothing; the wording check was done here instead (no hypothesis wording such as 'direct completes more' appears, and no sentence outruns i

gate_release_machine has no evidence/checks.json; its per-number comparisons exist only as rows in release_surface_gate.json without per-row check_ids, so machine_check references to it are null in my checks and the runner can only match them through gate_release_document ids.

The claim register and metrics label the AOV intervals 'student' while the frozen analysis plan registered welch_t for H-CHANNEL-AOV; the release page shows only '0.95 interval', so this is not a release defect, but the analysis stage's interval method label disagrees with the registered method.
release/report.md shows no per-card period string in the By-channel section; the period is stated once in the title and dashboard period field, which I accepted as on-page for a single-page report.
summary: All 42 gate-enumerated rendered numbers re-derived independently and exact; Wilson bounds, reconciliation identities, label binding (n, 0.95, period), generator literal scan, quarantine and shipping_total absence all pass. Two reader-visible release defects block: the report header population line says 'delivered only' over the whole page, which is false for the orders figure (cancelled/pending included, 24597+19934=44531), and the four estimate cards in dashboard_data.json carry bounds but neither n nor the interval level, so a dashboard reader meets a rate/AOV without its sample size or 0.95
